description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It includes parsing of currency strings, optional filtering by tenant, project, and date range, and merges data from multiple sources to produce a summarized report.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: A helper function that safely converts currency-like strings (e.g., '$0.108255') or other inputs into numeric values, handling nulls, undefined, and non-finite numbers.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that queries and aggregates agent cost and usage data from MongoDB collections, applies filters, merges results, and returns a summarized report with optional pagination.
